TypeLeast：按一下，说话。再按一下，文字写到光标处。

## 本次更新 / What is new

<!-- typeleast-update:zh -->
- 新手引导里直接填整理模型。
- 整理稿直接插入，不再做本地检查。
- 名称有依据才改，说得通的照写。
<!-- /typeleast-update -->

<!-- typeleast-update:en -->
- Set up the cleanup model right in the setup guide.
- The cleaned text is inserted directly, without local checks.
- Names change only with evidence; a name that makes sense is kept.
<!-- /typeleast-update -->
